preconditions.expression: 1 <= k <= n <= 1024 and k * k == k and n * n == n
preconditions.description: n and k are powers of two.
The total number of queries is at most (3n^2)/(2k).
The memory can be reset at most 30000 times.

postconditions.description: The output diversity d is the number of distinct values in the array a.
